parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: The job ID. You can obtain the job ID by using the API at https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460565.html.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The enterprise identity (also called enterprise ID), in string format. You can obtain it from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, for example: https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrgId】

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: The pipeline ID. You can obtain it from the pipeline link, for example: https://flow.aliyun.com/pipelines/【PipelineId】/current
